segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: SUSPICIOUS SCARF RESIDUE IDENTIFIED,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: a metallic voice clicks from the snow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You and the fox freeze.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: One of the Nutcracker soldiers has stopped right in front of the dumpster. Its wooden head slowly rotates a full one-hundred-and-eighty degrees backward, until its unblinking black eyes lock directly onto you and the fox.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CLACK-CLACK.

segments.speaker: soldier
segments.text: UNAUTHORIZED CANINE DETECTED,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the soldier rattles.

segments.speaker: soldier
segments.text: UNRECONSTRUCTED YOUTH DETECTED. SURRENDER FOR IMMEDIATE FESTIVE INTEGRATION.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Festive integration?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the fox gasps, his fur standing straight on end.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I'll have you know I am already exceedingly festive! I once wore mistletoe in my tail for three consecutive fortnights!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Five more soldiers round the corner, raising wooden staffs that hum with crackling violet electricity. They box you into the brick wall. There's nowhere left to run.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Alright, clever guy,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you say, looking down at the fox.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: You're a detective? What's the plan?

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The plan?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The fox laughs, a high-pitched, nervous sound that squeaks like a rusty hinge.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The plan is elementary! We employ the ancient art of... OH GINGER-SNAPS, WE'RE GOING TO BE FIREWOOD!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His British accent is completely gone now.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He frantically grabs the brass compass, violently shaking it like an old ketchup bottle.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Work, you blasted pile of clockwork! Work!

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: What does it do?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you shout as the soldiers close in, their painted teeth grinning.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I DON'T KNOW! I FOUND IT IN THE CLOCK TOWER!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The fox raises his furry paw and slams his palm down onto the large copper plunger on top of the compass!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CLIIIIICK-WHIRRRRRR!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Inside the brass casing, the spinning gears scream. The spiderweb cracks on the glass face erupt with blinding, glacial-blue light!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A freezing shockwave of wind explodes through the alley, blowing the soldiers' fuzzy hats straight off their wooden heads!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The brick walls seem to bend like rubber. The snowy ground drops out from beneath your boots. Before you can scream, the blue light twists into a roaring vortex of frost, gears, and temporal lightning—swallowing you and the fox whole!
